summary.text: Dale Conoyer is the Democratic candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 65, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Wendy Hausman.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Saint Louis University in 2025 and works in retail.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Conoyer described himself as a young man with an honors bachelor's degree from Saint Louis University who wants to devote his life to representing his home in the state capital.
He said Missouri taxes should be used for Missouri infrastructure, and that he supports strengthening the citizens' ballot initiative process.
He also said he supports economic development in northern St. Charles County, including raising levees to open floodplains to investment.
